MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful next choice because it adds front-door alerts and two-way communication to my existing interest in security cameras.",
    "The Echo Show 8 interests me as a display alongside my Fire TV and security devices, giving it a different purpose from another streaming device."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Fire TV Stick offers little immediate benefit because my history already includes a 4K Stick and a Fire TV television; the Cube's hands-free control is not enough to make me replace them.",
    "The charging cables and iPad stylus do not connect to a need I have shown, and I have no evidence that the stylus fits a device I own.",
    "The camera bundle, Echo Dot, and Echo Show 5 are relevant, but I would choose the standalone doorbell and larger display before buying overlapping alternatives."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in Fire TV seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest more streaming devices, even though I already have that function covered.",
    "My interest in connected home devices seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any Alexa accessory, even when I have no specific use for it."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more interested in adding a useful capability, such as seeing and speaking to front-door visitors, than buying another device that repeats what I already have.",
    "Related products still need a concrete purpose: I would wait on a smart plug until I had an appliance to control, and I would choose one suitable display rather than several similar devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my home security and entertainment interests but sometimes confused a useful addition with more devices that serve the same purpose."
}
